note: Vibes-Coded conformance vectors for action-ref-v1. action_ref = SHA-256(JCS(preimage)) over the frozen 4-field tuple {action_type, agent_id, scope, timestamp}. Cross-verified byte-identical against giskard09/action-ref-conformance. A conformant verifier reproduces PASS on positives and REJECT on negatives (grammar_reject before hashing for non-canonical timestamps; recompute_mismatch otherwise). Both verdicts and every reject reason must be observed.

reject_reasons.grammar_reject: timestamp is not a canonical RFC 3339 UTC millisecond string before hashing
